decision.explanation: The question asks for the designer of the Gunbus. Source segment D1S1 explicitly states: 'The Burgess Type O Gunbus was an American pusher biplane fighter designed and built by the Burgess Company'. This directly identifies 'Burgess Company' as the designer. The slot hint 'person' is satisfied by the entity name representing the organization responsible for the design, as no individual human name is provided in the text. Other documents (D2) discuss unrelated topics (British Wars, Vickers). The candidate C0 matches this finding.
